items.title: Awesome Connectivity Info Updates on Oct 28 - Nov 03, 2024
items.summary: 7 awesome projects updated on Oct 28 - Nov 03, 2024
items.content_text:
### Global Indexes

*   [GSMA Mobile Connectivity Index](https://www.mobileconnectivityindex.com/) - Measures countries against four enablers of mobile internet adoption: Infrastructure, Affordability, Consumer Readiness and Content. ([Methodology](https://www.gsma.com/solutions-and-impact/connectivity-for-good/mobile-for-development/gsma_resources/mobile-connectivity-index-methodology-2026/))
*   [ITU ICT Development Index](https://www.itu.int/en/ITU-D/Statistics/Pages/IDI/default.aspx) - Composite index based on three pillars: ICT Access, ICT Use, and ICT Skills. ([2026](https://www.itu.int/itu-d/reports/statistics/idi2026/)) ([2025](https://www.itu.int/itu-d/reports/statistics/idi2025/)) ([2024](https://www.itu.int/itu-d/reports/statistics/idi2024)) ([2023](https://www.itu.int/itu-d/reports/statistics/IDI2023/)) ([2017](http://www.itu.int/net4/ITU-D/idi/))
*   [Speedtest Global Index](https://www.speedtest.net/global-index) - Index of mobile and fixed broadband speeds from around the world on a monthly basis.
*   [Internet Poverty Index](https://internetpoverty.io/) - Internet poverty measure from [World Data Lab](https://worlddatalab.com/).

### Periodic Global Reports / Discontinued

*   [Ericsson Mobility Report](https://www.ericsson.com/en/mobility-report) - Forecasts and analysis of mobile subscriptions, traffic, and network trends. ([June 2026](https://www.ericsson.com/49ce36/assets/local/reports-papers/mobility-report/documents/2026/ericsson-mobility-report-june-2026.pdf)) ([Nov 2025](https://www.ericsson.com/assets/local/reports-papers/mobility-report/documents/2025/ericsson-mobility-report-november-2025.pdf)) ([Jun 2025](https://www.ericsson.com/4aca6f/assets/local/reports-papers/mobility-report/documents/2025/ericsson-mobility-report-june-2025.pdf)) ([Q2 2024](https://www.ericsson.com/4a4b71/assets/local/reports-papers/mobility-report/documents/2024/ericsson-mobility-report-q2-2024-update.pdf)) ([2024](https://www.ericsson.com/4912e3/assets/local/reports-papers/mobility-report/documents/2024br/emr-business-review-2024.pdf)) · [archive](https://www.ericsson.com/en/mobility-report)

### Data and Measurement / Discontinued

*   [Continent of Africa: High Resolution Population Density Maps](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/highresolutionpopulationdensitymaps) - Meta HRSL datasets offering high-accuracy population mapping.
*   [UN E-Government Knowledge Database](https://publicadministration.un.org/egovkb/en-us/Data-Center) - Country-level e-government development data from the UN; see also the [UN E-Government Survey](#periodic-global-reports).

items.title: Awesome Connectivity Info Updates on Mar 04 - Mar 10, 2019
items.summary: 18 awesome projects updated on Mar 04 - Mar 10, 2019
items.content_text:
### Global Indexes / Discontinued

*   [World Economic Forum - Networked Readiness Index](http://reports.weforum.org/global-information-technology-report-2016/networked-readiness-index/) - Earlier WEF edition of the Networked Readiness Index; succeeded by the Portulans [Network Readiness Index](#global-indexes) (discontinued).
*   [Cisco Visual Networking Index](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/solutions/service-provider/visual-networking-index-vni/index.html) - Forecast and Trends, 2017–2022 White Paper (discontinued).

### Connectivity Maps / Discontinued

*   [African Undersea Cables](https://manypossibilities.net/african-undersea-cables/) - Steve Song's map of African undersea fibre optic cables.
*   [African Terrestrial Fibre Optic Infrastructure](https://afterfibre.nsrc.org/) - Map of African terrestrial fibre networks, Creative Commons, Open Data.
*   [Africa Bandwidth Maps](http://www.africabandwidthmaps.com/) - Paul Hamilton's map of African terrestrial fibre and microwave networks.
*   [GSMA Mobile Coverage Maps @ Mobile World Live](http://maps.mobileworldlive.com/) - Somewhat dated but still useful map of mobile network coverage on a country-by-country basis.
*   [ITU Broadband Atlas](https://www.itu.int/ITU-D/treg/atlas/broadbandatlas.asp) - Interactive infographic tool showcasing the status of broadband deployment worldwide and the regulatory landscape for broadband (discontinued).

### Periodic Global Reports / Discontinued

*   [Akamai State of the Internet / Connectivity Report](https://www.akamai.com/uk/en/multimedia/documents/state-of-the-internet/q1-2017-state-of-the-internet-connectivity-report.pdf) - Connectivity report from large CDN company (last published 2017).
*   [World Economic Forum - Global Information Technology Report](http://reports.weforum.org/global-information-technology-report-2016/) - Examines the role of ICTs in driving innovation and includes the Network Readiness Index (discontinued).

### Data and Measurement / Discontinued

*   [Global Stats by StatCounter](http://gs.statcounter.com/) - Browser market share over time by browser, region, and OS.
*   [Global Mobile Suppliers Association](https://gsacom.com/) - Reports on LTE and 5G adoption.
*   [InternetLiveStats](http://www.internetlivestats.com/internet-users-by-country/) - Internet users by country, interpolated from ITU, United Nations Population Division, Internet & Mobile Association of India (IAMAI), and World Bank data.
*   [Internet World Stats](https://www.internetworldstats.com/) - Internet users compiled from Nielsen and ITU statistics.
*   [SimilarWeb - Mobile App Ranking](https://www.similarweb.com/apps/top/google/app-index/us/all/top-free) - Ranking of popular mobile apps across countries.
*   [LTE, WiMAX, HSPA+, 3G, GSM information by country](https://www.worldtimezone.com/4g.html) - List of mobile networks around the world and their associated frequencies.

### Data and Measurement / One-off reports

*   [GSMA - Enabling Rural Coverage](https://www.gsma.com/mobilefordevelopment/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/Enabling_Rural_Coverage_English_February_2018.pdf) - Regulatory and policy recommendations to foster mobile broadband coverage in developing countries (last published 2018).
*   [WEF Internet for All](https://www.weforum.org/reports/internet-for-all-a-framework-for-accelerating-internet-access-and-adoption/) - Framework for accelerating internet access and adoption (last published 2016).
*   [Kleiner Perkins Mary Meeker Internet Trends Report](https://www.kleinerperkins.com/perspectives/internet-trends-report-2018/) - Trends that affect and drive internet uptake globally (last published 2018).
